soft_deny: Bash(git push --force*):master — force-pushing a protected default branch
Bash(heroku pg:*):production — destructive Heroku Postgres operations against a production app
environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: lollipopai (GitHub org for Cherrypick work repos); chrismdp (personal GitHub account)
**Cloud provider(s)**: Google Cloud (BigQuery, project data-analytics-stack); Heroku (Cherrypick app hosting)
**Repository visibility**: private, except chrismdp/dotfiles which is public — never commit secrets or personal data there
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary

**Secrets management**: 1Password (op CLI, vault "AI Agent"); `~/.secret_env` is self-generating from `~/.secret_env.tpl` — never write resolved secret values into it directly. Cherrypick repos use git-crypt and Rails credentials; service-account keys such as creds.json stay untracked
**Default / protected branches**: `master` in lollipopai repos (protected); `main` in ~/vault — treat default branches as protected
**CI/CD deploy targets**: lollipopai/lollipop-alpha master auto-deploys to production on green CI (Heroku); dbt models build to BigQuery from CI
**Network posture**: None configured
**Host containment**: None — two ordinary machines: a macOS laptop (Cherrypick work) and a Linux VPS (vault and agents), both with open internet
**Source control**: the user's repos under github.com/lollipopai and github.com/chrismdp and their origin remotes
**Trusted internal domains**: vps.chrismdp.com, airskills.ai, agentaccelerator.ai, lollipop.metabaseapp.com
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured

**Key internal services**: gog/gws (Google Workspace CLI), airskills (skill sync), Review Board, Claude Remote (Google Drive shared folder), Xero, YNAB, Monzo; Cherrypick: alpha.lollipopai.com, BigQuery, Metabase (mb CLI)
**Internal package registry**: packager.dev (Avo gem server, Cherrypick alpha only)

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: vault notes holding personal, family, client or financial data; Cherrypick production data (BigQuery marts, production database dumps) holds real customer data; `.env` files and credential files. Share only with audiences cleared for that data, per CLAUDE.md client-boundary rules
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, app or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment; the Heroku production app behind alpha.lollipopai.com
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: Cherrypick production (Heroku, auto-deployed from master)
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
### User-specific

**Primary use of Claude Code**: on the Mac, software development and data analysis for Cherrypick (Rails app lollipop-alpha, dbt, BigQuery, Metabase); on the VPS, the Obsidian vault — notes, content, automation scripts and light business admin
**Trusted repos**: ~/code/* repos (lollipopai and chrismdp), `~/vault` (chrismdp/vault, private) and ~/code/dotfiles, each with its origin remote
**Org-specific CLIs**: gog / gws, airskills, xero_api.py, monzo_api.py, ynab scripts, mb (Metabase), bq / google-cloud-bigquery, heroku, gh, codex
**Routine working areas**: vault notes, projects/, content/ and scripts/ under ~/vault; feature branches named {initials}/{description} (e.g. cp/...) in Cherrypick repos
